blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: تُعْرَضُ الْفِتَنُ عَلي الْقُلُوبِ كَالْحَصِيرِ عُودًا عُودًا، فَأَيُّ قَلْبٍ أُشْرِبَهَا نُكِتَ فِيهِ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ، وَأَيُّ قَلْبٍ أَنْكَرَهَا نُكِتَ فِيهِ نُكْتَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ، حَتَّي تَصِيرَ عَلَي قَلْبَيْنِ، عَلي أَبْيَضَ مِثْلَ الصَّفَا، فَلَا تَضُرُّهُ فِتْنَةٌ مَا دَامَتِ السَّمواتُ وَاْلاَرْضُ، وَاْلآخَرُ أَسْوَدُ مِرْبَادّاً كَالْكُوزِ مُجَخِّياً لَا يَعْرِفُ مَعْرُوفاً وَّلَا يُنْكِرُ مُنْكَرًا إِلَّا مَا أُشْرِبَ مِنْ هَوَاهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب رفع الامانة والايمان من بعض القلوب...،رقم:٣٦٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Just as the reeds of a mat are joined to one another, one after another, so trials (fitnah) will keep coming upon the hearts of people continuously, one after another. Whichever heart accepts any one of these trials, a black spot will be formed in that heart. Whichever heart does not accept it, a white mark will be imprinted in that heart. In this way hearts will become of two kinds. One is the heart that is white like a smooth stone. As long as the heavens and the earth remain, no trial will be able to affect that heart. (Just as nothing stays on a smooth stone because of its smoothness, so, because Iman is firm in his heart, no trial can affect it.) The other kind of heart is like a black clay cup turned upside down. Because of many sins the heart turns black; just as nothing stays in a cup turned upside down, neither dislike of sins nor the light of Iman stays in that heart.
